maintenance.title: MANUAL MAINTENANCE
maintenance.cleanup.description: Frees up disk space by removing leftovers such as temporary files and the contents of the Recycle Bin.
cleanup.title: PC CLEANUP
cleanup.temp_files.description: Deletes the contents of your %TEMP% folder and of C:\Windows\Temp, leaving alone anything changed in the last day, and the .pf files in C:\Windows\Prefetch. Windows rebuilds the Prefetch files, so the first launch of each program may be slightly slower. Files in use are skipped.
cleanup.hidden_junk.description: Deletes the thumbnail and icon caches in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer, the Windows error reports (WER folders in %LOCALAPPDATA% and %PROGRAMDATA%), the crash dumps in %LOCALAPPDATA%\CrashDumps and the memory dumps (C:\Windows\Minidump and MEMORY.DMP). Files in use are skipped.
cleanup.caches.description: Deletes the Windows Update download cache (C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution\Download), the Delivery Optimization cache and the shader caches of DirectX, NVIDIA and AMD in %LOCALAPPDATA%. Windows and your games rebuild them when needed. Files in use are skipped. Browser caches are not touched.
cleanup.recycle_bin.description: Permanently deletes everything in the Recycle Bin of every fixed drive (C:\, D:\, ...). Deleted items cannot be restored afterwards.
